item.title: A thought on Parashat Vayera: Chasing Kindness
item.description:
Why did Avraham go out looking for guests on the third day after his circumcision, when no one could blame him for missing the misvah? Rav Moshe Feinstein's question in Darash Moshe, and his answer that for hesed we must actively pursue the opportunity, a duty that is unique among misvot between people.

When is the right time to pray Minha? Yishak is linked to Minha, which corresponds to the afternoon Tamid offering. The shiur contrasts the Sepharadi preference to pray later, at Minha Ketanah, with the Ashkenazi practice of praying from Minha Gedolah, in light of the principle of hastening to perform misvot.

item.description:
